## Summary

I implemented the path-traversal hardening in two source files.

**`airflow-core/src/airflow/utils/helpers.py`** — `validate_key`: added a `..` check *after* the existing type/length/character-set checks, so it applies to keys that are structurally valid but contain consecutive dots (e.g. `'my..key'`, `'..'`):

```python
if ".." in k:
    raise AirflowException(
        f"The key {k!r} must not contain consecutive dots ('..') to prevent path traversal"
    )
```

`{k!r}` wraps the key in single quotes, producing exactly `The key 'my..key' must not contain consecutive dots ('..') to prevent path traversal`.

**`airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dagrun.py`** — `validate_run_id`: added a `..` check *before* the regex/pattern checks (after the empty-string guard):

```python
if ".." in run_id:
    raise ValueError(
        f"The run_id provided '{run_id}' must not contain '..' to prevent path traversal"
    )
```

The message contains the required substring `must not contain '..'`. Since URL-encoded variants like `manual__..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd` still contain the literal `..` substring, plus plain `my..run` and bare `..`, a simple `".." in run_id` substring check covers all the required forms.

I did not touch anything under `tests/`. Note: I couldn't run the project's `uv`/`breeze` test path (the sandbox can't compile `python-ldap`), but a standalone `ruff 0.15.7` formatted and passed both files.
